categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Yinghe Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: lithium-ion battery specialized production equipment and electronic cigarettes. The lithium battery segment focuses on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of automated equipment for lithium battery production, serving key processes from electrode preparation to cell assembly. The electronic cigarette segment, operated mainly through its subsidiary Skor Technology, focuses on brand development, product design, and sales of e-cigarettes and related accessories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies in lithium battery equipment such as coating machines, rolling machines, slitting machines, laser cutting and winding machines, stacking machines, and automated assembly lines. It integrates automation, digitalization, and MES systems for production process management. For e-cigarettes, it emphasizes proprietary brand R&D, product innovation, and compliance with international certifications like TPD. Production is mostly order-driven with modern ERP and CNC equipment to ensure quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading lithium battery manufacturers and automotive companies such as CATL, BYD, EVE Energy, Gotion High-Tech, LG Energy Solution, BMW, Volkswagen, and others. The end markets served are primarily new energy vehicles (NEVs), energy storage systems, and 3C digital products. The electronic cigarette business targets major global markets including the US, EU, UK, Russia, Southeast Asia, and Middle East, with expanding brand presence in Europe and North America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Huizhou, Dongguan, Jiangxi, and Zhejiang provinces. It has expanded its international footprint with subsidiaries and sales offices in Germany, the UK, the US, Russia, Indonesia, and Hungary. Overseas sales account for over 50% of revenue, with products exported to countries including Germany, South Korea, France, the US, Canada, Spain, and Malaysia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yinghe Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on manufacturing specialized automated production equipment for battery manufacturers. It is positioned as an equipment supplier enabling battery cell production rather than producing battery cells or raw materials. In the e-cigarette segment, it acts as a downstream branded product manufacturer and seller.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes becoming a world-class global lithium battery equipment solution provider and a leading enterprise in the electronic vaporization field. It emphasizes high-end product R&D, international market expansion, digital and management innovation, and enhanced customer service. Key R&D initiatives target advanced coating, rolling, laser cutting, stacking, and assembly technologies, as well as new product development for solid-state batteries and high-speed automated lines. The company also invests in talent acquisition and digital transformation to support innovation and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized lithium battery production equipment and electronic cigarette products. The company operates on an order-based production model for lithium battery equipment, with contracts specifying technical requirements and delivery schedules. The e-cigarette segment primarily sells self-branded products directly to customers. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yinghe Technology is a leading player in the domestic lithium battery equipment manufacturing industry with over 18 years of experience. It holds a strong market position with recognized technological leadership and a broad customer base including top-tier battery and automotive manufacturers. It is among the first domestic companies to expand internationally in this sector. In the electronic cigarette market, its subsidiary Skor has gained TPD certification and is expanding rapidly in Europe and North America, competing with established global brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 8.52 billion, a 12.58% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 503 million, down 9.14%. Overseas sales grew by 25.02%, accounting for over 50% of total revenue. The company maintains total assets of around RMB 14.76 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 6.58 billion. Despite some revenue decline, the company continues to invest heavily in R&D and international expansion, indicating a focus on sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yinghe Technology emphasizes its industry-leading technological innovation, high product quality, and comprehensive digital and intelligent manufacturing solutions. Its lithium battery equipment features advanced automation, integration, and energy efficiency, helping customers improve production efficiency and reduce costs. The company’s global localized service network ensures responsive support. In the e-cigarette segment, product quality, patented technology, and strong brand presence in regulated markets differentiate it from competitors.
